To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the key to business success is in the people, the key to business excellence is in the management of people.

there is a need to move from a “quality management system” approach to a “performance management system” approach, and that the key to success lies in the development of an organisational culture in which the learning organisation can thrive.
the key to achieving business excellence lies in harnessing the human resources of a company, and in the process of doing so, the organisation itself is transformed into a learning organisation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to the management of human resources which will help companies to achieve business excellence, and to become “excellent companies” in their own right.
understanding the barriers which inhibit companies from reaching their full potential, and the factors which contribute to the development of the excellent company.
the development of the human resources of an organisation to achieve business excellence.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the authors have identified some of the key issues and have set out a way of exploring them in greater depth to enable the development of a way of resolving some of the problems.

the key to achieving excellence is the development of the organisation as a learning organisation, with a performance management system which is aligned to business strategy, and which is based upon a self‐assessment framework.
the authors have identified a number of key issues which are critical to success in the modern competitive environment and have offered a number of suggestions as to how they can be addressed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the key issue in achieving business excellence lies with the people within an organisation and the way they are managed.
the quality of the people in a company is the most critical factor in its success.
the key to achieving excellence lies in harnessing human resources to the fullest extent possible.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are no quick fixes.
there is no single “best way” of achieving business excellence.

the learning organisation, the performance management system and the self‐assessment framework are the three key elements of the strategic quality management system which will help companies to achieve the excellence they desire.
